name: sm_shade_rake
purpose: a clawed hand of shadow raking across armour, quick dark swipe with a smoky whoosh

name: sm_shade_reach
purpose: a long arm of darkness stretching out and grabbing, slow heavy whoosh ending in a muffled grip

name: sm_thing_tear
purpose: a monstrous thing tearing into flesh, wet heavy rip with a low snarl

name: sm_thing_lunge
purpose: something huge lunging out of darkness, a rushing whoosh and a deep guttural roar at the end

name: sm_dark_chain
purpose: darkness leaping from one body to the next, two quick dark magic cracks with a whispering tail

name: sm_gone_missing
purpose: a creature swallowed whole into the dark, a heavy inward gulp collapsing to sudden silence

name: sm_shade_burst
purpose: a shadow bursting apart into smoke, soft dark detonation with hissing wisps
